hypothesis: After an independently admitted semantic lineage exists, an external selected-head CAS binding exact parent and semantic root can enforce one current sibling. When composed with protected state, exact head+root comparison detects one-sided state/selector rollback while the opposite side survives.
strongest_counterhypothesis: Selected-head CAS is not a whole-system rollback authority. If protected state and the selected-head store roll back together to a mutually consistent historical pair, the local relation cannot detect rollback. An out-of-domain monotonic authority or externally coordinated recovery protocol is still required.

construction_findings_from_closed_duplic: Git source digest and semantic/identity digest spaces must not be silently conflated: current repository Git heads are 40-hex SHA-1 while semantic roots/head identities in these candidates are 64-hex SHA-256.
